conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly! The act of observing one coin instantly reveals the state of the other, illustrating the interconnectedness of entangled particles.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: This shared fate means that if one coin is heads, the other must be tails, and vice-versa, without any prior communication between them.

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
